# Deployment Requirements Checklist: STRIDEr Slack App Deployment

**Purpose**: Validate whether the requirements for deploying the STRIDEr Slack app from the repository are complete, clear, consistent, and review-ready before tasks are generated and implementation starts. Focus: credentials and secrets, the pipeline's behaviour in each app state, and recovery.
**Created**: 2026-11-16
**Feature**: `specs/006-slack-app-deployment/spec.md`

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements stated for every credential the feature depends on, including the one the plan added for writing repository secrets, with who creates it and what happens when it expires? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Plan research Decision 3, Gap]
- [x] CHK002 Is there a requirement for what the Slack app contains while no event delivery address is set, now that research found events cannot be sent without one? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, Plan research Decision 7]
- [x] CHK003 Are the values Slack returns at creation that are not stored (client ID, client secret, verification token) covered by a requirement, or only by a plan decision? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, Plan data-model]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for removing the Slack app or retiring STRIDEr, or is that explicitly excluded? [Gap]
- [x] CHK005 Is the fact that the repository is public, so logs, run summaries and issues are public, reflected in the requirements about secrets and failure issues? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-026, Plan research Decision 10]
- [x] CHK006 Is the manual verification of the event delivery address, found in research, recorded in the spec as something the later feature inherits? [Gap, Spec §User Story 5, Plan research F13]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Does "its settings" in FR-008 and FR-009 say which files or values count, precisely enough to decide whether a given merge contacts Slack? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK008 Is "replying in a thread it is part of" precise about whether a reply must mention STRIDEr, given that the answer decides whether STRIDEr can read whole channels? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002, Plan research Decision 8]
- [x] CHK009 Is "an app home page" in FR-004 defined so that it is clear whether the messages tab, which direct messages need, is allowed? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "MUST say what a person should do next" specific about where it is said (run summary, log, issue) and to what level of detail? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK011 Is "the run as a whole MUST show as failed" defined for a design where the Slack part and the agent part are separate runs on the same commit? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012, Plan research Decision 6]
- [x] CHK012 Is "finds the recorded app gone" defined in a way that separates a deleted app from Slack being unreachable or the credential being refused? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK013 Is "no more time than is needed" in FR-012 measurable, or should it be removed now that the two pipelines are independent? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK014 Does FR-007 ("on every branch push") agree with the plan, where only pushes that change the Slack files are checked? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007, Plan contracts §1]
- [x] CHK015 Does SC-006 ("exactly the permissions in the app definition") agree with the plan's built manifest, which differs from the app definition while no address is set? [Consistency, Spec §SC-006, Plan data-model]
- [x] CHK016 Does User Story 5, scenario 2 ("no file other than the setting had to change") agree with the plan now that supplying the address also turns on event subscriptions? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 5, Plan research Decision 7]
- [x] CHK017 Do FR-013 ("Branches MUST NOT create or change any Slack app") and the plan's branch validation, which renews and rewrites the pipeline credential from a branch run, agree on what a branch run may change? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Plan research Decision 5]
- [x] CHK018 Does SC-005 (exactly one step that cannot be automated) agree with the setup the plan implies, which also has the owner create a Slack configuration token, create a GitHub token and store the bot token? [Consistency, Spec §SC-005, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK019 Do FR-010 (undo hand-made changes) and FR-025 (fail until reinstalled) agree on the result of a scheduled run when both a hand-made change and a missing permission exist? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK020 Is the spec's assumption "Issues are for scheduled runs" consistent with the owner's answer, which did not limit issues to scheduled runs? [Assumption, Spec §FR-026, Spec §Clarifications]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK021 Can SC-002 ("100% of branch pushes with an invalid app definition fail") be measured, given that "invalid" is partly decided by Slack and partly by project rules? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK022 Is SC-010 (ten runs in a row) measurable within the feature's own validation, and does it say who checks it and when? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010, Plan quickstart]
- [x] CHK023 Does SC-012 define "its cause" well enough to decide whether two failed runs share one issue or need two? [Clarity, Spec §SC-012, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK024 Is there a success criterion for FR-023 and FR-024 (creation only by a hand-started run; nothing created otherwise)? [Gap, Spec §FR-023, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK025 Is there a success criterion for FR-012 (independence of the Slack part and the agent's deployment)? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for the state "app created but never installed", including what merges and scheduled runs do in it? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions, Plan data-model]
- [x] CHK027 Are requirements defined for a removed permission, as distinct from an added one? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025, Gap]
- [x] CHK028 Are requirements defined for the stored bot token being wrong or revoked, as distinct from it lacking a permission? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for the scheduled run not running at all, for example because the hosting service has switched it off? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Plan research F17, Gap]
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements defined for the creation run being started while the recorded app still exists but the stored values have been lost? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, Gap]

## Recovery & Edge Cases

- [x] CHK031 Is the recovery from a lost pipeline credential specified as a requirement on the documentation, with the starting state and the end state named? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK032 Does the edge case "the pipeline changes the Slack app and then fails to store an updated value" say which values, and whether the Slack change is left in place? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK033 Does the replacement-app flow state as a requirement that everything using the old values must be updated, and name who is told and how? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK034 Is the edge case left to planning (an address set with nothing listening) now resolved in the spec, and not only in the research? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan research Decision 7]

## Security Requirements

- [x] CHK035 Is least privilege stated as a requirement for the pipeline's own credentials, not only for the Slack app's permissions? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK036 Is it a stated and accepted requirement-level decision that branch runs can read the credentials, with the condition under which that must be revisited? [Assumption, Plan research Decision 5]
- [x] CHK037 Does FR-018 cover failure issues and run summaries as places a secret must not appear, in addition to the repository and logs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK038 Is the breadth of what STRIDEr can read in channels acknowledged in the requirements as accepted, or flagged for a decision? [Assumption, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003]

- [x] CHK039 Are the five facts research left unverified each tied to a requirement that depends on them, with what happens to that requirement if the fact is wrong? [Assumption, Plan research Open items, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK040 Is the hand-off to the later feature stated as requirements on this feature (what it guarantees) and not only as a plan contract? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 4, Plan contracts §3]
- [x] CHK041 Does the spec's Assumptions section still describe the Slack facts as unchecked, now that research has documented most of them? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan research Facts checked]

## Review 2026-11-16

Reviewed by the spec author at the project owner's request, after the owner's own read.
12 of 41 satisfied. The 29 left unchecked, by what would satisfy them:

**Already assigned to task T001 (spec wording to match research)**: CHK002, CHK006, CHK009,
CHK011, CHK014, CHK018, CHK034, CHK041.

**Wording, not yet assigned to a task**: CHK007 ("its settings" is not defined), CHK013
("no more time than is needed" has no measure), CHK017 and CHK036 (the spec does not say a
branch run may renew the pipeline credential, or that branch runs can read it), CHK023
("its cause" against one issue per label).

**Gaps worth closing in the spec**:

- CHK001, CHK035: nothing requires the pipeline's own credentials to be least-privilege,
  or says what happens when the token for writing secrets expires. The plan covers both.
- CHK005, CHK037: FR-018 names the repository and logs but not run summaries and issues,
  which are public here.
- CHK024, CHK025: no success criterion for "creation only by a hand-started run" or for
  independence from the agent pipeline.
- CHK029: nothing covers the scheduled run being switched off by the hosting service.
- CHK030, CHK032: two recovery cases are unspecified: the app exists but its stored values
  were lost, and which values "fails to store an updated value" means.

**Gaps of low value; the plan or data model already answers them**: CHK003 (values Slack
returns that are not stored), CHK004 (removing the app is not addressed or excluded),
CHK010 (where "what to do next" is said), CHK012 (deleted app against Slack unreachable),
CHK021 ("invalid" is not defined), CHK028 (a revoked bot token), CHK039 (two of the five
unverified facts have no stated consequence if wrong).

Notes on items marked satisfied: CHK015 and CHK016 hold because only events, not
permissions, are held back while no address is set. CHK022 and CHK031 are satisfied by
tasks T041 and T027 and not by the spec's own text.

### Owner's decisions on this review, 2026-11-16

- CHK005, CHK037: the hosting service masks secrets in pipeline logs. The requirement to
  add is that secrets may not appear in issues or pull requests. Added to task T001.
- CHK024, CHK025, CHK029: ignore. Left unchecked; no change will be made for them.
- CHK030, CHK032, CHK001, CHK035, CHK007, CHK013, CHK017, CHK036, CHK023: added to task
  T001.
- CHK003: the client ID and client secret are to be stored as secrets for the later
  feature's deployment. Design documents updated; spec change added to T001.
- CHK004: out of scope. Added to T001.
- CHK010: ignore.
- CHK012: separate a deleted app from Slack being unreachable or the credential being
  refused. Added to T001; tests added to T015 and T023.
- CHK021: Slack publishes a manifest schema (`slackapi/manifest-schema`). The offline
  check now validates against a copy of it, and "invalid" is defined. Added to T001, T002,
  T006, T007 and T008.
- CHK028: add to the spec. Added to T001.
- CHK039: consequences for the two remaining facts added to `research.md`.

### After the spec was updated, 2026-11-16

Task T001 was applied to `spec.md` at the owner's request and the items it covers were
re-checked: 24 more are satisfied, 37 of 41 in all. The four left unchecked are the ones
the owner chose to ignore: CHK010, CHK024, CHK025 and CHK029.
